punchline: Mozart's first four piano concertos, written at eleven, contained no original music, and his first masterwork came only after eighteen years of training.
thirty_sec: Mozart is the classic born genius, but Geoff Colvin looks at the house he grew up in. His father Leopold was a violin teacher who wrote a book on the subject in the year Wolfgang was born, began systematic training by age three, and wrote down his first scores. The first four piano concertos were arrangements, and the first masterwork came at twenty-one.
